Mr. Ashish Asthavadi a/w Hindavi Ludbe i/b Rahul Karnik,
 Advocates for the Petitioners.

 Respondent Nos. 4 and 5.

Coram : B. P. Colabawalla &
 M.M. Sathaye, Jj.

Date : July 17, 2023
 P. C.
1.
The above writ petition raises the issue of payment of interest and compensation under the provision of the National Highways Act, 1956.

It is the case of the Petitioners that the issue raised in the present petition is squarely covered by the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Union of India and Anr. v/s. Tarsem Singh and Ors.1, and which decision has been followed by this Court 1(2019) 9 SCC 304 JULY 17, 2023 Sneha Chavan 13 wp 7224-22.doc

Relying upon these decisions, it is the case of the Petitioners that the beneficial provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 [for short 'the 2013 Act] are made applicable to acquisitions under the National Highways Act, 1956.

3. Considering these facts and acceding to the request of the learned counsel appearing on behalf of NHAI, the above matter be stood over to 08.08.2023.
JULY 17, 2023 Sneha Chavan 13 wp 7224-22.doc

4. If for any reason, the clarification application cannot be taken up by the Hon'ble Supreme Court,
then Respondent No.5 (NHAI) and who is a party to the clarification application, is also directed to place on record before this Court, the clarification application filed before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

5. Stand over to 08.08.2023.
6.
